code: get_timeseries(   rics,   fields = "*",   start_date = NULL,   end_date = NULL,   interval = "daily",   raw_output = FALSE,   calendar = NULL,   count = NULL,   corax = NULL,   debug = FALSE,   verbose = FALSE )

title: Retrieve Historical Time Series Data — get_timeseries
text: rics character string list character strings specifying RICs retrieve data . fields character string list strings specifying fields retrieve. Available fields: `c("TIMESTAMP", "VALUE", "VOLUME", "HIGH", "LOW", "OPEN", "CLOSE", "COUNT")`. Default: `"*"` (fields). start_date character string specifying start date format `" Default: 100 days current date. end_date character string specifying end date format `" Default: current date. interval character string specifying data interval. Possible values: `"tick"`, `"minute"`, `"hour"`, `"daily"`, `"weekly"`, `"monthly"`, `"quarterly"`, `"yearly"`. Default: `"daily"`. raw_output logical value. `TRUE`, returns data raw JSON format. `FALSE`, returns data frame. Default: `FALSE`. parameter ignored `raw_output = TRUE`. Default: `FALSE`. calendar character string specifying calendar type. Possible values: `"native"`, `"tradingdays"`, `"calendardays"`. count integer specifying maximum number data points retrieve. corax character string specifying correction method. Possible values: `"adjusted"`, `"unadjusted"`. debug logical value. `TRUE`, prints debug messages, including JSON request response. Default: `FALSE`. verbose logical value. `TRUE`, prints messages. Default: `FALSE`.
